title: Lifetime Withdrawal Benefit Rider Specifications — Ashgrove IncomeShield and IndexEdge Tiers
content:
**Rider specifications page — guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit, Fixed Indexed Annuities**

The guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefit rider is part of the contract on the Ashgrove IncomeShield 7 and Ashgrove IncomeShield 10. On the four IndexEdge tiers the rider is not part of the contract.

| Specification | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rider included | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Annual rider fee, as a share of the benefit base | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 1.10% | 1.20% |
| Highest rider fee Ashgrove may ever charge | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 1.50% | 1.60% |
| Benefit base bonus, as a share of premiums received in the first contract year | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 10% | 15% |
| Simple annual roll-up rate | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 7% | 8% |
| Number of anniversaries on which the roll-up is credited | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 10 |
| Youngest covered person's age at which lifetime withdrawals may start | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Reduction to the lifetime withdrawal percentage for joint lifetime income | 0.5 percentage point | 0.5 percentage point | 0.5 percentage point | 0.5 percentage point | 0.5 percentage point | 0.5 percentage point |
| A required minimum distribution above the lifetime withdrawal amount is not treated as an excess withdrawal | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Definitions used on this page

- **Rider fee.** A yearly fee stated as a share of the benefit base and deducted from the contract value on each contract anniversary. The current fee on the IncomeShield 7 is 1.10% and may never exceed 1.50%; on the IncomeShield 10 it is 1.20% and may never exceed 1.60%.
- **Benefit base bonus.** An amount added to the benefit base only — 10% on the IncomeShield 7, 15% on the IncomeShield 10 — of the premiums received in the first contract year.
- **Roll-up.** A simple annual credit to the benefit base on each anniversary, stated as a share of premiums plus the benefit base bonus: 7% on the IncomeShield 7 and 8% on the IncomeShield 10, credited on up to 10 anniversaries and ending earlier when lifetime withdrawals begin.
- **Income age.** Lifetime withdrawals may start once the covered person, or on joint income the younger covered person, has reached 50.
- **Joint reduction.** When joint lifetime income is elected, the lifetime withdrawal percentage is reduced by 0.5 percentage point.

### Hypothetical figures

| Hypothetical first-year premium | Benefit base bonus, IncomeShield 7 (10%) | Benefit base bonus, IncomeShield 10 (15%) |
|---|---|---|
| 100000 | 10000.00 | 15000.00 |
| 60000 | 6000.00 | 9000.00 |

| Hypothetical benefit base on an anniversary | Rider fee, IncomeShield 7 (1.10%) | Rider fee, IncomeShield 10 (1.20%) |
|---|---|---|
| 150000 | 1650.00 | 1800.00 |
